senses.gloss:
p. p. 
__1 Said, spoken. 
__2 Uttered, spoken (opp. to अनुमित or संभावित). 
__3 Told, addressed; असावनुक्तो ऽपि सहाय एव [[Ku. 3. 21.]] 
__4 Indicated; असता छाययोक्ताय सदाभासाय ते नमः [[Bhāg. 8. 3. 14.]] 
-क्तम् A speech, words collectively; a sentence. 
-क्तम्, -क्ता A stanza of four lines with one syllabic instant, (there being one long or two short syllables in each). 
-Comp. 
-अनुक्त a. spoken [Page1381-1] and not spoken. 
-उपसंहारः a brief description, resume, peroration, recapitulation. 
-निर्वाहः defending an assertion. 
-पुंस्कः a word (feminine or neuter) of which also a masculine exists, and the meaning of which differs from that of the masculine only by the notion of gender. 
-प्रत्युक्तम् speech and reply, discourse. 
-वर्जम् ind. except the case mentioned. 
-वाक्यम् a dictum, decree.

f. 
__1 Speech, expression, statement; उक्तिरर्थान्तरन्यासः स्यात् सामान्यविशेषयोः [[Chandr. 5. 120]]; शूद्रविट्क्षत्रविप्राणां यत्रर्तोक्तौ भवेद्वधः [[Ms. 8. 104.]] 
__2 A sentence. 
__3 The power of expression, the expressive power of a word; as in एकयोक्त्या पुष्पवन्तौ दिवाकरनिशाकरौ [[Ak.]] 
__4 A worthy speech or word, maxim.
